selected_evidence.summary: The default and sole installed kernel boot entry contains audit=1.

selected_evidence.requirement: Operating-system release and installed kernel retained
selected_evidence.summary: CentOS Stream 10 and kernel-core 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 were retained.

Healthy baseline boot ID df8bab0d-5c09-47a2-a150-4ce12d0f9549 was captured, reboot acknowledged, and node1 recovered with changed boot ID f4475f93-1c4b-4e71-99ea-f5152e100817 and system state running.
The live command line includes audit=1; current-boot kernel logs report auditing enabled and audit_enabled=1.
